page.overview:
Who is Riku?

Riku is a playable character in Final Fantasy Record Keeper who could be initially recruited during the Collector's Event Key to Another World as a Mastery Reward for completing the event's Destiny Island - Seashore stage.

Riku originates as the deuteragonist of the Kingdom Hearts series who ends up being manipulated by various evil forces thanks to the darkness in his heart, eventually learning to control it and rejoining his best friend Sora fighting for the light.

Riku's appearance in Final Fantasy Record Keeper is based on his original appearance from the first Kingdom Hearts game. He wears a sleeveless yellow shirt with black straps across it, two-toned blue pants, and black gloves. His weapon is the Soul Eater, a dark sword shaped like a red and black wing with an eye set into the handle. He has silver hair and turquoise eyes. His original character designer is Tetsuya Nomura.

Riku is competitive with his friend and rival Sora, but his jealousy over the close friendship between Sora and Kairi contributed to his fall to darkness. He admits a major reason he was so competitive with Sora growing up was because he secretly worried he was inferior.
